# Release 1.23 — Stance Engine L1 (rules buy/hold/avoid)

**Status:** Outline — freeze when 1.22 ships  
**Milestone:** `1.23`  
**Parent strategy:** [Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md](../Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md)  
**Architecture source of truth:** [../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md](../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md)  
**Rule:** Do not edit this file to mark done or change scope after `Approved for freeze`. Status → GitHub only.

---

## Outcome

The app computes a deterministic **Buy / Hold / Avoid** (labels may include **Reduce** as a fourth state if implemented consistently) for **stocks and mutual funds** from **stored Tier A facts only**, with **transparent factor scores and evidence bullets**. UI shows a **Stance strip** on instrument detail (Simple for beginners, Factor detail for experienced) and can expose stance on screener rows.

This is the **product policy pivot**: after 1.23 ships, Wealth Orbit may present purchase-oriented stances **only** via this Stance Engine contract. Releases **1.18–1.19 remain refuse-buy/sell** until this engine exists; agents must not teach 1.19 chat to emit Buy/Avoid before 1.23/1.27.

**SEBI / advisory registration is out of scope** for this engineering release (stakeholder decision). Still ship clear in-product “research / decision-support, not a registered advisor” style honesty copy without designing a legal compliance program here.

---

## Locked decisions

| Decision | Choice | Agent implication |
|----------|--------|-------------------|
| Stance production start | **L1 rules/scorecards first** | No LLM required to ship labels |
| Label authority | **Rules engine only** in L1 | LLM/agent later may explain, never override, without re-run |
| Data source | Stored Tier A metrics only | No live scrape inside stance request path |
| Cost | Free local compute | No paid model for L1 |
| Audiences | One engine, two UI presentations | Do not maintain two scoring systems |
| Instrument coverage | Stocks + mutual funds | Indexes are out of stance unless trivially added later |
| Missing data | Lower confidence + `missing[]`; may force Hold/Avoid-unknown policy | Never invent fundamentals |
| Equity honesty | Depends on 1.2 quality | Do not score known-lying fields as truth |
| Microservice | Stance stays in modular monolith | Package under StanceEngine module (1.20) |

### Label set (normative default)

Use exactly these string enums unless an approved addendum changes them:

- `buy`  
- `hold`  
- `avoid`  

Allowed extension (if implemented in the same release with tests): `reduce` (portfolio-oriented; primarily used in 1.24 — L1 may emit it only with documented rule).

---

## Stance response contract (normative JSON shape)

Every successful stance computation MUST return:

| Field | Type | Rules |
|-------|------|-------|
| `instrument_id` | string | Stable app id (stock symbol key or scheme id as used elsewhere) |
| `instrument_type` | `"stock"` \| `"fund"` | |
| `label` | enum above | Required |
| `confidence` | number 0–1 or enum low/med/high | Document mapping in code |
| `factors` | array | Each: `{ name, score, weight?, direction?, note? }` |
| `evidence` | string array | 3–7 short bullets citing stored facts |
| `as_of` | object | Per-source as-of dates used |
| `missing` | string array | Factors skipped due to absent data |
| `engine_version` | string | Semver or date-version of rule pack |
| `strategy_context` | omitted in L1 | Added in 1.25 |

**Immutability rule for later releases:** L3/L4 may add `explanation` fields but must copy `label` / `factors` / `evidence` from this contract or from a re-run of the engine — never silently alter `label`.

---

## Factor families (minimum viable L1)

Agents implementing L1 must document the exact formulas in code + a short RULES.md or docstring module. Minimum families:

### Stocks

- **Quality** — e.g. ROE/ROCE, margin stability, if present in stored fundamentals  
- **Valuation** — e.g. PE/PB/PEG honesty rules from 1.2; null-safe  
- **Momentum / risk** — from latest technicals and/or recent returns if Tier B present; if Tier B missing, mark momentum `missing` rather than fabricating  
- **Balance-sheet risk** — net debt / leverage only when inputs exist (1.2 honesty)

### Mutual funds

- **Return** — from `mutual_fund_metric_snapshots` periods  
- **Risk** — volatility/drawdown-like metrics if stored  
- **Cost** — expense ratio from enrichment when present  
- **Manager / consistency** — tenure-aware only if 1.8 data exists; else missing  

**Aggregation:** weighted score → thresholds → label. Thresholds must be constants in one module (no magic numbers scattered in UI).

---

## UX requirements

- **Stance strip** on stock detail and fund detail: label + 3–7 bullets + as-of + link/toggle to Factor detail.  
- Beginner **Simple** view: plain language summary of evidence (template strings OK in L1; LLM prose is 1.26).  
- Experienced **Factor detail**: table/list of factor scores.  
- Screener: optional column or badge for stance when computation is cheap enough (batch or cached).  
- Honest empty: if Tier A insufficient, show “Stance unavailable — missing data” listing `missing[]`, not a fake Hold.

---

## Foundation

- [ ] StanceEngine module owns scoring; MarketResearch only supplies facts  
- [ ] No provider HTTP inside stance compute path  
- [ ] Persistence optional but recommended: cache latest stance per instrument + `engine_version` + computed_at (private or shared read model — prefer **shared cache table in Postgres** for market-wide L1, since L1 is not user-specific yet)  
- [ ] `engine_version` bumps whenever thresholds/weights change  
- [ ] Unit tests for null/missing inputs → no crash, no invented numbers  
- [ ] Policy note in docs: 1.18–1.19 refuse advice until 1.23; after 1.23 stance is allowed via engine only

## Out of scope

- LLM explanations (1.26)  
- Strategy/backtest merge (1.25)  
- Portfolio-aware “hold existing / avoid new buy” overlay (1.24)  
- Agentic chat presenting stance (1.27)  
- Live trading / order tickets  
- SEBI registration workflows  
- User-editable weight UI (Later; keep constants in code for L1)  

---

## Exit

User opens a stock and a fund with sufficient Tier A data and sees Buy/Hold/Avoid with evidence bullets and factor detail; insufficient data yields honest unavailable; screener can show stance without live scrapes; all labels come from StanceEngine with `engine_version`.

---

## Agent planning instructions

1. **Do not** implement stance by prompting an LLM for the label.  
2. **Do not** change 1.19 behavior to allow buy/sell chat in this release — that is 1.27 after L1 exists.  
3. Read 1.2 honesty rules before using PEG/net debt/div yield.  
4. If Tier A is incomplete for the universe, ship per-instrument honest empty rather than blocking the whole release.  
5. Keep formulas in one module; UI only renders the contract.  
6. Free-tier: never trigger full-universe scrape to answer stance.  
7. One GitHub issue per checkbox; milestone `1.23`.  
8. After freeze, rule-weight tweaks that change labels require `engine_version` bump + tests; large product changes → new release/addendum.

## Policy pivot statement (copy for PRD/agents)

> Through release 1.19, the product refuses personalized buy/sell/switch advice.  
> From release 1.23, the product may show Buy/Hold/Avoid **only** as output of the Stance Engine contract.  
> Chat and LLM features must call the engine (or display stored engine output), not invent labels.
